title: Each type as a manager
caption:
Sixteen types, sixteen management styles. Which one do you work for, and which one are you?

One trusts you fully until a deadline slips. One knows you're burning out before you do. One fixes the broken thing at 6pm themselves. Swipe to find your manager.

The useful bit: give a Thinker the why, a Heart-led the meaning, a Guardian the plan and a Maker the freedom. It works on bosses too.

Send this to a new manager, or to the colleague who'd love it.
